comment: Checkpoint registry — single source of truth for which adapters are at which lifecycle state. Per slm-learning-082: candidate, staging, canonical, rejected, archived. Daemon (gad-monorepo phase 147) MAY auto-move low-blast-radius specialists from candidate to staging. NEVER auto-promotes to canonical. Updated by scripts/delta/promote_atomic.py and the (planned) registry-update hook in eval_candidate.py.

rejected.rejection_reason: Catastrophic forgetting confirmed per slm-learning-088. GAD-tools 25/30 (-17pp vs v2 specialist's 30/30). GSM8K 5/50 (-40pp vs math specialist's 25/50). HumanEval 0/10 unchanged (gap G8). Hypothesis from SL-T-04-03 falsified at rank=16 + 6572 combined pairs.
rejected.useful_for: negative-tier training data per slm-learning-073; SERA-style failure trajectory; counter-example for promotion gate

next_experiments: SL-T-04-02: stacking via PEFT multi-adapter (load v2 + math + tooluse simultaneously, route per call)
slm-learning-049: TIES / DARE-TIES merge of the 3 specialists into a single adapter
slm-learning-079: per-domain specialist ladder with router (the long-term answer)

candidates.notes: Below 0.85 gate — not eligible for auto-staging. But +18.7pp F1 over r=8 + unlocked unknown class (0.000 -> 0.462). Operator may promote with explicit stamp + accepted threshold lower than 0.85, OR queue augmentation/r=32 retrain.
next_options: accept as best-effort floor + move on

rejected.rejection_reason: F1=0.533 << 0.85 threshold. Unknown class F1=0.000 (8/8 mispredicted). Underfits per slm-learning-089.
rejected.useful_for: negative-tier training data; counter-example for r=16 promotion gate

attention_classifier.notes: Per slm-learning-072: rule-based v1 first; learned classifier becomes a Phase 05 candidate after we have a labeled golden set.
